doc.description:
Danger detector for the TU Delft Cyberzoo.
Processes the bottom strip of the camera image and divides it into columns. Each column receives a danger score from 0 (safe/green floor) to 100 (fully blocked). Green floor pixels are detected using simple YUV thresholds.
Results are stored in danger_scores[] and can be read by other modules via danger_detector_get_scores().
This module does NOT yet steer the drone – it only computes the scores.

define.name: DANGER_DETECTOR_CAMERA
define.description: Camera device to use for detection

define.name: DANGER_DETECTOR_NUM_COLUMNS
define.description: Number of columns to divide the image into

define.name: DANGER_DETECTOR_VERBOSE
define.description: Define to print scores every periodic cycle
